content.text:
I have inspected every responsive location. My findings:

- **p0387–p0388** — "exclusive control" over the Cap Collateral Account is a securities-account control mechanic granted **to the Issuer** (our party), not a supply restriction; p0388 actually limits the Issuer's own assertion of it.
- **p0427** — "nonexclusive jurisdiction" is a forum term, not exclusivity.
- **p0080 (§ 3.1 Engagement)**, **p0137 (Custodian)**, **p0150 (Marketing Agent)** — plain appointments of Cellco with no "sole and exclusive" wording and no covenant barring the Issuer from retaining others; Article VII expressly contemplates terminating the Servicer and appointing a Successor Servicer.
- No requirements, sole-source, or "shall not procure from any third party" covenant exists anywhere.

The preferred position is satisfied, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: Section 3.1 Engagement. The Issuer engages Cellco as the Servicer of the Receivables for the Issuer and the Indenture Trustee, and Cellco accepts this engagement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on our side, so it meets the preferred position and needs no redline. The operative engagement provisions are bare appointments of Cellco as Servicer (p0080), Custodian (p0137) and Marketing Agent (p0150) with no "sole and exclusive" designation, no requirements commitment, and no covenant barring the Issuer or Depositor from procuring comparable services from third parties; Article VII expressly permits terminating the Servicer and installing a Successor Servicer. The only instances of "exclusive" are unrelated: "exclusive control" over the Cap Collateral Account (p0387-p0388) is a securities-account control mechanic held by the Issuer, and p0388 in fact constrains the Issuer's own exercise of it, so it runs in our favour rather than against us; and p0427 refers to "nonexclusive jurisdiction," a forum term outside this rule. Because no exclusivity binds us, the fallback's category, 12-month, and performance-exit limits are not engaged.
